items.title: Who is pramod as professionally?
items.description:
I ran CI/CD pipelines at Capgemini, where I triaged build failures, debugged pods and wrote Python and Shell automation around Trivy scans and deployment checks.

After two years of freelance web delivery, I returned to DevOps full time in 2026 and built two end-to-end projects: a GitOps deployment on Amazon EKS and a DevSecOps pipeline with mandatory security gates.

I am looking for a DevOps, Cloud or SRE role where I can keep building reliable, automated delivery.
